title: The Asset of Kowloon
author: Kestrel Nakamura
blurb: Elodie Nakamura, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
